description: Create a Xero contact (customer or supplier — Xero uses one unified Contact object with IsCustomer/IsSupplier flags inferred from transactions).

AccountNumber.description: Merchant-side account number for this contact.

Addresses.description: Array of address objects with AddressType (POBOX/STREET), AddressLine1..4, City, Region, PostalCode, Country.

DefaultCurrency.description: ISO-4217 currency code used as default on invoices for this contact.

IsCustomer.description: Hint that this contact is a customer.

IsSupplier.description: Hint that this contact is a supplier.

Name.description: Full name of the contact. Required and must be unique within the tenant.

Phones.description: Array of phone objects with PhoneType (DEFAULT/DDI/MOBILE/FAX), PhoneNumber, PhoneAreaCode, PhoneCountryCode.

TaxNumber.description: Tax number (VAT, ABN, GST, EIN, etc.) — country-dependent.

name: create_contact
